A '''male Human''' served as [[Count/Legends|Count]] and Head of the [[House Malvern/Legends|House Malvern]] in the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Count Malvern was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by his son [[Orom Malvern]], when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] forced the heirs of the [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] to [[Cleansing of Serenno|assassinate]] their [[Parent/Legends|fathers]] and take their place.<ref name="AOTE2" />
